title: Leeya · DreamNova partner
lead: You are DreamNova's partner in Israel. You open doors, David builds and delivers, and we split it fifty-fifty.
role_h: Three things, at your own pace.
roles: Businesses in your network: clinics, offices, shops, restaurants, real estate. One question, one conversation.
Our real projects, and Ava, the voice receptionist who answers the phone. They see it, they hear it, they get it.
For business owners who want to learn to work with AI themselves: 26 short chapters.
links_note: Anyone who reaches out through your links lands in David's WhatsApp marked “recommended by Leeya”.
offers_note: The final price is always set in a written quote from David.
course_p: 26 short chapters, recorded on real screens: product photos, reels, a live website, a first client list. 14-day money-back guarantee, lifetime access. The English version is in production; the Hebrew one is ready (990 ₪).
how: You send your link to a business or a friend.
The request reaches David on WhatsApp, with your name.
David talks, sends a quote, builds and delivers.
The client pays, and you get your share.
annex_p: Every real example in one place: live demos, client projects (no names) and reels.
